name: Chisholm Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233741 catalog (10 sites): no proximity-to-water flags, sites 'situated in a forest'; satellite at 45.4747,-110.9572: the loop's west arc sits ~33-40 m inside continuous dense conifer, back from the open East Fork delta, main pool 300 m+ NW. Treeline screens any lake sightline

name: Boulder Creek Campground
evidence: FS page: 13 sites, 'heavily wooded', Wise River along W border; satellite at 45.6517,-113.0670: nearest pad (trailer) ~20 m from the ~10 m cobble channel through scattered conifers, loop ~100 m back. No pad at the bank, no per-site map; riverview stands

name: Eureka Reservoir Fishing Access Site
evidence: satellite at 47.8780,-112.3136 (z1): east camp loop on open grass ~13 m from shore, camper parked ~5-10 m from water. DEM 1257 m on loop = 1257 m on lake: at lake grade, not below the dam. FWP drawdown note doesn't downgrade

name: Lichen Cliff Fishing Access Site
evidence: FWP FAS page photo: campsite table + fire ring on a gravel pullout with open bank to Little Prickly Pear Creek a few m away; satellite at 46.9389,-112.1218: pullout ~7-10 m from the ~5 m channel, thin shrub fringe only. Creek <30 m, so creekside

name: Martinsdale Reservoir Fishing Access Site
evidence: satellite at 46.4504,-110.2815 + 46.4499,-110.2785: shore road/camping on open grass ~20-35 m from water across an unused wet-grass/gravel apron at the high-water margin; FWP photo shows RV camped on open grass by the shore. Drawdown doesn't downgrade

name: Painted Rocks State Park
evidence: satellite near full pool at 45.6840,-114.3018: nearest RV pad (trailer) ~25-32 m from the beach's inland edge behind scattered pines; other sites deeper in trees; the open gravel area by the water is ramp parking. No pad within the on-water bound; open sightline holds lakeview

name: Newlan Creek Reservoir Fishing Access Site
evidence: satellite at 46.6429,-110.9367 (z1): RVs parked at the vegetation/high-water line, ~7-10 m from it, with an open bare apron to the drawn-down water. Measured to high water per the gate, so drawdown doesn't downgrade
